crossRefs.note: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that…
Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.
I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
My beloved is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
I was asleep, but my heart was awake. It is the voice of my beloved who knocks: “Open to me, my sister, my love, my…
His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies.
In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of…
My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of…
“Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it…
He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press…
He began to tell the people this parable. “A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into…
“I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

translations.web: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
translations.bsb: I will sing for my beloved a song of his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.
translations.kjv: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
